title: Probar los servicios con dobles de Mockito
acceptance: WHEN an avistamiento targets a missing report, a found-pet report or a RESUELTO report THE SYSTEM SHALL throw the domain exception and Mockito SHALL verify `guardar` and `notificar` were never called.
WHEN a valid avistamiento is registered THE SYSTEM SHALL call `repositorio.guardar` before `publicador.notificar`, verified with `InOrder`.
WHEN `ServicioReportes` is built with an empty creators map THE SYSTEM SHALL throw `OperacionNoPermitidaException` on `registrar` and never call `guardar`.

WHEN a lost-pet request without zone is registered THE SYSTEM SHALL throw `DatosInvalidosException` and never call `guardar`; WHEN a report is resolved THE SYSTEM SHALL call `guardar` with that report.
WHEN `./mvnw -q test -Dtest='ServicioAvistamientosMockTest,ServicioReportesMockTest'` runs THE SYSTEM SHALL exit 0 with every test of both classes passing.

title: Agregar reconstrucción, IDs atómicos y pruebas de dominio
acceptance: WHEN `ReportePerdida.reconstruir(...)` receives a date, a RESUELTO state and a list of sightings THE SYSTEM SHALL return a report with that same date, state and sightings.
WHEN a reconstructed RESUELTO report receives a new sighting THE SYSTEM SHALL throw `OperacionNoPermitidaException`.
WHEN 8 threads request 1000 identifiers from one `GeneradorIdReportes` THE SYSTEM SHALL return 1000 distinct values, and after the 999th THE SYSTEM SHALL return `PF-1000`.
WHEN each of the 9 origin→destination state pairs is evaluated THE SYSTEM SHALL allow only ACTIVO→RESUELTO and ACTIVO→CERRADO.

WHEN a lost-pet request lacks zone, description, contact medium, pet, pet name or species, or a found-pet request has a null, empty or blank animal description THE SYSTEM SHALL throw `DatosInvalidosException`.
WHEN `./mvnw -q clean test` runs THE SYSTEM SHALL exit 0 with every earlier test still passing.

title: Definir coordenadas, borrador y puertos del asistente
acceptance: WHEN coordinates are exactly ±90 latitude and ±180 longitude THE SYSTEM SHALL accept them, and WHEN either exceeds its range by 0.0001 THE SYSTEM SHALL throw `DatosInvalidosException`.
WHEN only one of latitude and longitude is given THE SYSTEM SHALL throw `DatosInvalidosException`.
WHEN `aproximada()` is applied to 4.723581, -74.041749 THE SYSTEM SHALL return 4.724, -74.042.
WHEN an empty `BorradorReporte` is asked what is missing THE SYSTEM SHALL answer TIPO, ZONA, DESCRIPCION, CONTACTO in that order.
WHEN a complete lost-pet draft is converted with `aSolicitud()` THE SYSTEM SHALL produce a request that `CreadorReportePerdida` accepts.
WHEN `./mvnw -q clean test` runs THE SYSTEM SHALL exit 0, including every test that still uses the Corte 1 constructor `new Ubicacion(zona, referencia)`.

title: Construir el intérprete y el servicio de comandos de voz
acceptance: WHEN the interpreter reads `perdí un perro llamado Max en Chía`, `Perdi una gata llamada Nala en Cedritos` or `PERDÍ UN PERRO LLAMADO MAX EN CHÍA` THE SYSTEM SHALL return REGISTRAR_PERDIDA with especie, nombre and zona.

WHEN it reads `encontré una gata blanca en Cajicá` THE SYSTEM SHALL return REGISTRAR_ENCONTRADA; `ver reportes`, `listar reportes` and `mostrar reportes` SHALL return LISTAR_ACTIVOS; `consultar reporte PF-001`, `consultar reporte pf 1` and `consultar reporte pf001` SHALL return CONSULTAR with id `PF-001`.

WHEN the text is null, empty, only spaces, longer than 200 characters, lacks species or zone, or is `cómprame un perro` THE SYSTEM SHALL return NO_RECONOCIDO, and WHEN a valid phrase is exactly 200 characters THE SYSTEM SHALL still recognize it.
WHEN `ServicioComandosVoz` receives a lost-pet phrase THE SYSTEM SHALL call `GestionReportes.registrar(PERDIDA, …)` with the dictated name, species and zone, verified with `ArgumentCaptor`.
WHEN it receives an unrecognized phrase THE SYSTEM SHALL never call `registrar`, and for `ver reportes` THE SYSTEM SHALL return exactly what `listarActivos()` returned.
WHEN the app boots THE SYSTEM SHALL expose `ProcesadorComandosVoz` and `InterpreteComandoVoz` beans, and `sh scripts/humo.sh` SHALL exit 0.

title: Implementar el adaptador de persistencia H2
acceptance: WHEN a lost-pet report with coordinates is saved and read back THE SYSTEM SHALL return the same pet name, contact medium and latitude.
WHEN a found-pet report is saved and read back THE SYSTEM SHALL keep its `descripcionMascota`.
WHEN an unknown id is looked up THE SYSTEM SHALL return an empty `Optional`.
WHEN ACTIVO, RESUELTO and CERRADO reports are saved THE SYSTEM SHALL list only the ACTIVO one as active.

WHEN a saved report is resolved or receives a sighting and is saved again THE SYSTEM SHALL persist the new state and the sighting, and WHEN it is read back THE SYSTEM SHALL keep its original `fechaCreacion`.
WHEN `./mvnw -q verify -Dtest=NINGUNA -Dsurefire.failIfNoSpecifiedTests=false -Dit.test=RepositorioReportesH2IT` runs THE SYSTEM SHALL exit 0 against a real embedded H2.

title: Crear los DTO web y el manejador de errores
acceptance: WHEN a `SolicitudReporteDTO` with `tipo` PERDIDA is converted THE SYSTEM SHALL build `SolicitudReporte.paraPerdida` with a `Mascota`, and with ENCONTRADA THE SYSTEM SHALL build `paraEncontrada` with `descripcionMascota`.
WHEN `ReporteDTO.resumen(reporte)` maps a report THE SYSTEM SHALL round its coordinates to 3 decimals and mask the contact: `3001234567` → `300•••••67`, `sofia@correo.co` → `so•••@correo.co`.
WHEN `ReporteDTO.detalle(reporte)` maps the same report THE SYSTEM SHALL keep the full contact and list its sightings without the spotter's contact.

WHEN `ManejadorErrores` handles `DatosInvalidosException`, `ReporteNoEncontradoException` or `OperacionNoPermitidaException` THE SYSTEM SHALL answer 400, 404 or 409 with the body `{"error": "<mensaje de la excepción>"}`.
WHEN `./mvnw -q test -Dtest=MapeoDtoTest` runs THE SYSTEM SHALL exit 0 with every mapping and handler test passing.

title: Implementar el servicio del asistente con respaldo regex
acceptance: WHEN the first extractor returns data THE SYSTEM SHALL merge it into the draft and report that extractor's `nombre()` as `fuente`.
WHEN the first extractor throws or returns empty THE SYSTEM SHALL use the next one, and WHEN none answers THE SYSTEM SHALL keep the draft unchanged and report `fuente` `ninguna`.
WHEN fields are missing THE SYSTEM SHALL return as `pregunta` the question of the first missing field, and WHEN none is missing THE SYSTEM SHALL return `Listo. Revisa la tarjeta y publica.`
WHEN a turn produces a type but the draft has no description THE SYSTEM SHALL use the turn's text as `descripcion`.
WHEN `ExtractorRegex` reads `perdí un perro llamado Max en Chía, mi número es 300 123 4567` THE SYSTEM SHALL extract PERDIDA, `Max`, `perro`, `Chía` and `3001234567`.
WHEN the app boots THE SYSTEM SHALL expose an `AsistenteReportes` bean, and `sh scripts/humo.sh` SHALL exit 0.

title: Exponer la API REST de reportes, voz y asistente
acceptance: WHEN `POST /api/reportes` receives a valid lost-pet body THE SYSTEM SHALL answer 201 with the `ReporteDTO`, and WHEN the zone is missing THE SYSTEM SHALL answer 400 with `{"error": …}`.
WHEN `GET /api/reportes/{id}` asks for an unknown id THE SYSTEM SHALL answer 404, and WHEN `POST /api/reportes/{id}/resolver` hits an already resolved report THE SYSTEM SHALL answer 409.
WHEN `POST /api/reportes/{id}/avistamientos` succeeds THE SYSTEM SHALL answer 201 with the updated report.
WHEN `POST /api/voz` gets a recognized registration THE SYSTEM SHALL answer 201, a list or query 200, and an unrecognized phrase 422 with the help message.
WHEN `POST /api/asistente/turno` receives `{borrador, texto}` THE SYSTEM SHALL answer 200 with `borrador`, `faltantes`, `pregunta`, `fuente` and `listo`.
WHEN ArchUnit runs THE SYSTEM SHALL confirm that no class in `adaptadores.entrada.web` depends on `application.service`, and `sh scripts/humo.sh /api/reportes` SHALL exit 0.

title: Conectar H2 a la aplicación y cargar datos de ejemplo
acceptance: WHEN the application context starts THE SYSTEM SHALL inject `RepositorioReportesH2` as the `RepositorioReportes` port.
WHEN a report is registered and then resolved through `GestionReportes` THE SYSTEM SHALL read it back from H2 with state RESUELTO.
WHEN the web application starts with default properties THE SYSTEM SHALL list the sample cases Luna, Max, Gata gris and Copito among the active reports.
WHEN the console demo runs THE SYSTEM SHALL still print `Creado: PF-001` for its first report, because sample data loads only in the web application.
WHEN `./mvnw -q clean verify` runs THE SYSTEM SHALL exit 0 with unit and integration tests passing and write `target/site/jacoco/index.html`.

title: Agregar el extractor con Claude y su tope diario
acceptance: WHEN the fake `ClienteModelo` returns `{"tipo":"PERDIDA","nombre":"Luna","especie":"perro","zona":"Cedritos"}` THE SYSTEM SHALL return a draft with those four values, and `nombre()` SHALL be `claude`.
WHEN the model returns text that is not valid JSON THE SYSTEM SHALL return `Optional.empty()` so the service falls back to regex.
WHEN the daily cap is reached THE SYSTEM SHALL return `Optional.empty()` without calling `ClienteModelo`.
WHEN `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` is blank THE SYSTEM SHALL return `Optional.empty()` without calling `ClienteModelo`, and the app SHALL still boot with health 200.
WHEN ArchUnit runs THE SYSTEM SHALL find `com.anthropic` imported only inside `petfinder.adaptadores.salida.ia`.
WHEN the model id is resolved THE SYSTEM SHALL read `PETFINDER_IA_MODELO` with default `claude-sonnet-5` in `ConfiguracionIa`, and `ClienteModeloAnthropic` SHALL contain no model literal.

title: Escribir las pruebas de sistema y la guía de pruebas
acceptance: WHEN a lost pet is created over HTTP THE SYSTEM SHALL answer 201, show ACTIVO, accept a sighting with 201, resolve with 204, show RESUELTO and reject a new sighting with 409, using only the id returned by the POST.
WHEN a report has no zone THE SYSTEM SHALL answer 400, WHEN `PF-999999` is requested THE SYSTEM SHALL answer 404, and WHEN a report is resolved twice THE SYSTEM SHALL answer 409.
WHEN `perdí un perro llamado Max en Chía` is sent to `/api/voz` THE SYSTEM SHALL answer 201 and the new id SHALL appear in `GET /api/reportes`.
WHEN an unintelligible phrase is sent to `/api/voz` THE SYSTEM SHALL answer 422 and the size of `GET /api/reportes` SHALL not change.

WHEN "Max, perro, Chía" is created by form, by `/api/voz` and by an assistant draft published through `POST /api/reportes` THE SYSTEM SHALL return the same tipo, nombre, especie and zona in the three reports.

WHEN `docs/pruebas.md` and the README section `Cómo ejecutar` are read THE SYSTEM SHALL document the command of every test level (`./mvnw test`, `./mvnw verify`, `k6 run`) for macOS/Git Bash (`./mvnw`) and PowerShell (`mvnw.cmd`), because the assignment requires every test type to run with a command documented in the README.

title: Automatizar dos flujos de UI con Selenium
acceptance: WHEN `./mvnw -q -Pui verify` runs with headless Chrome THE SYSTEM SHALL pass the flow that writes a report in `entrada-texto`, completes the contact, publishes with `boton-publicar` and finds the new case in `lista-casos`.
WHEN it runs the flow that opens a case, presses `boton-la-vi` and sends a sighting with `boton-enviar-pista` THE SYSTEM SHALL show the confirmation in `mensaje`.
WHEN the tests locate elements THE SYSTEM SHALL use only `data-prueba` selectors inside Page Objects and explicit `WebDriverWait`, and SHALL contain no `Thread.sleep`.
WHEN `./mvnw -q clean verify` runs without `-Pui` THE SYSTEM SHALL not execute any `*UIT` class, so machines without Chrome still pass.
WHEN the README section `Cómo ejecutar` is read THE SYSTEM SHALL document `./mvnw -q -Pui verify` as the command of the UI tests and say they need Chrome.
